stories.summary: A Russian drone strike hit a school in Kyiv, causing a fire but resulting in no injuries among students, according to Ukrainian authorities. The attack is part of a broader wave of air assaults by Moscow, which also targeted a main bridge in the city, disrupting transport.

stories.summary: Recent fluctuations in bond yields are causing significant disruptions in financial markets worldwide. High yields are increasing borrowing costs, which may slow economic growth and negatively impact stock prices and other investments.

stories.title: Judge Dismisses Vandalism Case Against Former Olympian
stories.summary: A D.C. Superior Court judge has permanently dismissed the vandalism case against former Olympian David Hearn, with the dismissal ordered with prejudice. This decision means the case cannot be refiled in the future.

stories.title: Cornell University to Conduct Independent Review of Alleged Gang Rape Incident
stories.summary: Cornell University has agreed to an independent review regarding its handling of an alleged gang rape incident that occurred at the Chi Phi fraternity house in 2024. This decision follows reports that no criminal charges were filed in connection with the case.

stories.title: Rapper Rick Ross Arrested on Domestic Violence Charges in Miami Beach
stories.summary: Rapper Rick Ross was arrested by Miami Beach police on charges of felony battery by strangulation and misdemeanor battery. The charges stem from accusations that he assaulted a woman at his home, including allegations of hitting and choking her.
